source_key_points: 3 A PEEK BEYOND THE POINT 3.1 The Need for Smaller Units Sonu’s mother was fixing a toy.
She brought another screw from the box and was able to fix the toy.
But when he observed them closely, he saw they were of slightly different lengths.
Sonu was fascinated by how such a small difference in lengths could matter so much.
He was also curious to know how little the difference was because the screws looked nearly the same.
What is the meaning of 2 7 cm (the length of the first screw)?
10 As seen on the ruler, the unit length between two consecutive numbers is divided into 10 equal parts.
To get the length 2 7 cm, we 10 go from 0 to 2 and then take seven parts of 1 .
10 10 We read 2 7 cm as two and seven-tenth centimeters, and 3 2 cm 10 10 as three and two-tenth centimeters.
Can you explain why the unit was divided into smaller parts to measure the screws?
